name: Inui Kouichi
source:
sótano’s owner. 

An open-hearted, helpful man with a tendency to poke his nose into other people’s business. 

He gives work to people who are having trouble or can’t get on their feet and have no place to go, but he’s got a good eye for people who’ll actually be useful. While he owns several restaurants and a detective agency, he’s an old man who lives a relatively simple, frugal lifestyle. He loves alcohol. 

”Don’t be ridiculous and get back to work. I’ll take it out of your paycheck.”

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=131]MangaGamer[/url]]
